title: CR-BRK-027 — Office / Time Clock edit attempt — non-editable roles
preconds: In Roles list: click Office; click Time Clock (View Mode as specified).
steps:
1. Configure a custom role per the Setup in Preconditions; assign to a test user and log in.
  2. Click Office and Time Clock in the Roles list.
expected:
Office and Time Clock cannot be edited — clicking opens a read-only permission summary (Concepts + Roles list).

Risk / Rationale: The editor opens (editable) instead of the read-only summary.
Spec Ref: Roles & Permissions List; Concepts
